scope: Read-only native GitHub CI/source inspection; only this delegated receipt was written. No workflow rerun, approval, review, merge or setting mutation.

pr262_head_change_during_review.note: The earlier head's Ubuntu CLI success is historical and is not transferred to the new head. Current checks below bind the new published head.

conclusions.queued: All inspected queued jobs had runner_id 0, no assigned runner name, standard GitHub-hosted labels and no executed steps. Some workflow-level pending runs had not yet created jobs.
conclusions.approvals: No pending deployment approvals were returned for any inspected active run. No inspected run reported waiting or action_required. An approval blocker was not confirmed.
conclusions.runner_availability: GitHub-hosted runners were actively processing PR255 and PR258 jobs during the sweep; statuses advanced. No global runner outage or impossible runner-label requirement was confirmed. The exact platform/account queue limit was not exposed.
conclusions.draft: Draft status does not explain these queues. At the current PR262 head, ci.yml contains no draft guard. Pages release-gates is publishing-only: workflow_dispatch on refs/heads/main with inputs.deploy. Its PR skip must not be described as draft-disabled.
conclusions.docs_only: PR259 changes job 135422776659 explicitly logged 'Docs-only change: heavy jobs skipped.' Its twelve heavy-job skips are change-scope conditions, not draft suppression. All current checks are green/skipped, but GitHub reports a main-merge conflict.
conclusions.promotion: No runtime candidate is qualified for promotion by this sweep. PR260 is stacked on a recovery branch rather than main. PR259 requires conflict/source reconciliation.

confirmed_failures.name: contracts-coverage
confirmed_failures.diagnostic: Compiler run failed: Yul exception, Variable expr_62396_address is 1 too deep in the stack; memoryguard was present.
confirmed_failures.actionability: A concrete coverage compilation failure, not an assertion of insufficient percentage or runner availability. No local compiler replay was run.

confirmed_failures.name: mythril
confirmed_failures.outcome: Analyzer step exited 1; workflow concluded failure.
confirmed_failures.actionability: Still a failed security gate. Main job log redirects detailed analysis into retained artifact; individual findings/completeness causes were not reassessed in this bounded sweep.

confirmed_failures.name: kit
confirmed_failures.test: root: preview and nginx agree on status, kit headers, validators and bodies

candidate_applicability.comparison: The differential test, static-export implementation and test helpers are blob-identical between PR260 and the current PR262 head.
candidate_applicability.limitation: exportStatic already preserves source st.mtime with fs.utimes. This sweep confirms the one-second validator mismatch, not its underlying precision/filesystem cause; no local replay or repair was attempted.

limitations: Live state may advance after each recorded observation.
The connector rejected the workflow-catalog endpoint as unsupported (HTTP 400), so no administrative workflow-state claim is made.
Workflow/job queue data does not identify the account/platform scheduling limit.
No broad local test was run.
